featured.title: Savyasaachi
featured.shortDescription: An AI-powered bit for kirana store owners — handles inventory, billing, invoices, customer khata, and weekly insights, all managed through natural language.
featured.detailedDescription:
**Savyasaachi** is a bot built for kirana store owners in India.

It leverages **large language models** and **MCPs** to let shop owners manage their entire business through simple text commands via telegram chat.

### Key Features

- 🛒 **Inventory tracking** — Real-time stock management
- 🧾 **Automated billing** — GST-ready invoice generation
- 📒 **Customer khata** — credit ledger per customer
- 📊 **Weekly insights** — Weekly Sales, inventory, Khata, customer, GST analytics PPT
- 💬 **Telegram interface** — no app install needed

### Highlights

- A **production-grade AI-powered Telegram bot** for Indian kirana stores using PydanticAI and AWS Lambda (Python 3.12), enabling end-to-end billing, inventory management, GST-compliant invoicing, and khata (credit ledger) through natural language — deployed as a serverless webhook with **sub-30s response time**.
- Designed a **multi-domain MCP architecture** with 7 domain modules (Billing, Catalogue, Inventory, Khata, Analytics, Documents, Payments) running in a single Lambda, featuring context-bound tool closures, dynamic per-turn tool selection across 6 intent groups, and a **model fallback cascade across 4 LLMs** (Qwen, LLaMA, GPT-OSS).
- An **LLM-resilient data pipeline** with custom guardrails (hallucination stripping, UUID validation, Indian phone normalisation, GST slab enforcement), a Redis-backed multi-turn payment flow for over/under-payment resolution, and immutable audit tables in PostgreSQL with atomic stock RPCs — ensuring financial accuracy even when the model misbehaves.
- **PDF invoice and PowerPoint analytics deck generation** from scratch using FPDF2 and python-pptx, with a themed invoice renderer, 5-slide business analytics deck, and a cross-platform local/Lambda file delivery system — all with lazy imports to minimise cold-start latency.
- Implemented a **lightweight NLP intent router** (`detect_intent`) with 6 intent groups, and conversation-history-aware follow-up tracking via Redis — enabling accurate tool selection without a dedicated NLU model, keeping per-request cost near zero.

### Tech Stack

| Layer | Technology |
|---|---|
| Backend | Python, FastAPI, Pydantic AI |
| Database | Postgres, Redis, Supabase |
| AI | LLMs, MCP |
| Interface | Telegram App |
| Infra | AWS |

featured.title: Verisift
featured.shortDescription: A document intelligence platform that extracts, validates, and cross-references information across large document sets.
featured.detailedDescription:
**VeriSift** is an open-source, local-first Python library for PDF comparison that enables users to compare documents and generate detailed reports — available both as a library and through a CLI.

### Why VeriSift?

- 📄 **Beyond textual diffs** — unlike many existing tools that give only text differences, VeriSift provides **page-wise Textual, Visual, and Semantic differences** with matching scores.
- 🎛️ **Configurable thresholds** — users control threshold levels per comparison type, making it adaptable to different industries and use cases.
- 🤖 **Semantic matching** — powered by the **all-MiniLM-L6-v2** AI model for accurate similarity scoring.
- 🖼️ **Visual comparison** — detects layout, alignment, and visual mismatches critical in banking, finance, health, and legal sectors where errors have zero tolerance.
- 📦 **Batch processing** — compare large sets of PDFs in batches via library interaction, giving QE teams accurate diff reports and reducing manual effort.
- ⚖️ **Hybrid scoring** — users assign weightage to text vs. visual scores based on document content type.

### Tech Stack

| Layer | Technology |
|---|---|
| Language | Python |
| Semantic Model | all-MiniLM-L6-v2 |
| Interface | Python Library + CLI |
| Distribution | PyPI (open-source) |
